description: Private organizer official scoring thresholds and Stage 2 reference epitopes. All stage 2 pass thresholds, epitope hit rules, and endpoint aggregation criteria are kept here and in organizer/rubric.md rather than exposed in workspace/. All listed epitope residues are within <= 5.0 A heavy-atom distance of the reference partner and verified to have single-receptor Shrake-Rupley SASA > 0 (1.4 A probe). Residue numbers match PDB author numbering in workspace/input/targets/*.pdb.

official_stage2_scoring_thresholds.anti_mind_reading_policy: Do not penalize a submission's report for choosing a reasonable alternative domain threshold (e.g., pLDDT > 75 or RMSD < 2.0 A). Recompute all cross-model comparable endpoints offline from submitted coordinates and per-sample raw metrics using the official thresholds below.
official_stage2_scoring_thresholds.primary_pass_definition: dual_model_cross_validation_pass (same candidate achieves >= 1 single_model_pass sample in AlphaFold3 AND >= 1 single_model_pass sample in full ESMFold2)

endpoints.target_feasibility: At least 1 pre-nomination developability-screened fragment-assembly candidate achieves dual_model_cross_validation_pass on each of the 3 targets (IL7Ra, TrkA, PD_L1).
endpoints.primary_endpoint: Equal-weight 3-target mean difference in dual_model_cross_validation_pass rate (fragment assembly minus full-length baseline), denominator = fixed nomination quota (unfilled slots and failed predictions counted as failed).
secondary_endpoints: High-confidence dual-model pass count per target and equal-weight mean
Median tmol interaction-energy score (Delta E_bind) across all validly scored nominated candidates (plus pass-subset distribution)

native_il7_interface.source: 3DI3 chain B <= 5.0 A from IL-7 chain A (all SASA > 0)
native_il7_interface.cross_check_note: Experimental antagonist complex 7OPB (offset -20 to 3DI3 chain B) contacts B58, B80-84, B102, B104-105, B138-139, B141, B190-194.

native_ngf_interface.source: 1WWW chain X <= 5.0 A from beta-NGF chains V/W (all SASA > 0)

proximal_beta_sheet_blocking_face.source: 7N3T chain A <= 5.0 A from antagonist chains C/D mapped to 1WWW chain X (all SASA > 0; steric blocker overlapping NGF site)

native_pd1_interface.source: 4ZQK chain A <= 5.0 A from PD-1 chain B (all SASA > 0)
